meta.description: VAD agent team v21 — SNH (Supervised Normality Head) EVAL session. The --snh_veto implementation (v179) is ALREADY LANDED AND VERIFIED by the main session after the first workflow attempt died on the 180s stall watchdog (foreground long-running Bash): _snh_veto terminal-slot video-level P(normal)>=tau veto (pipeline.py L3473, call sites L1818/L1980/L2355), model_snh.json + shared snh_features.py, [SNH-FIRE]/[SNH-VID] markers, SNH_FORCE_FIRE hook, CLI in run.py+batch_evaluate.py, flag default OFF byte-identical, py_compile+defaults verified. THIS RUN: (1) ONE queue-disciplined full-290 eval with --snh_veto (launcher + watcher-loop pattern — NO agent ever blocks on a long foreground command, the exact v20-proven idiom); (2) paired-log conf adjudication (analysis_bootstrap_ab.py --paired-log --marker SNH-FIRE --paired-mode conf, zero cross-run VLM noise); (3) the 4 pre-registered gates: paired mAP delta >= -0.003 AND abs mAP >= 0.16454 AND Normal-video FA-rate relative reduction >= 25% AND <= 1 GT-overlapping (IoU>=0.1) detection vetoed; (4) promote-or-close + records. Committed pipeline = v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal (all default-ON, full-290 ~0.173, v160_full 0.17254); cgr/ccr/cnv/kfd/tcp all default-OFF and stay so. Concurrency 2, never two evals at once (16 GB swap-thrash). Judged on the FA-rate objective with mAP only as non-inferiority constraint — NOT Normal-FP-for-mAP (banned 9).
